patch.dependencyAfter:
Requires-Dist: six>=1.16.0
Requires-Dist: oss2; extra == "oss"
Provides-Extra: oss
patch.scope: Only METADATA dependency declarations change: move oss2 to explicit oss extra and add six. Update METADATA Version, funasr/version.txt, dist-info paths and RECORD as distribution bookkeeping. All Python sources and other payload bytes remain identical. No model or package code is executed.

archive.note: The verified target-only local2 builder passed ZipInfo objects without a per-entry compression level; its effective zlib level was the default 6 despite the ZipFile level 9 argument. Pin level 6 explicitly and require the historical output digest. A different compressor result fails closed.

deliveryBoundary: This is a local metadata-only candidate recipe, not an immutable distribution URL, installer integration, model/platform acceptance or production security clearance. The source SBOM retains upstream FunASR 1.3.9 for vulnerability scanning; a local version must not hide its upstream identity.
